KIND: RESEARCH / DISCOVERY PROGRAM; never one independent confirmatory test over 2023-2026
OBJECTIVES: whether divergence adds value conditional on support
market states that distinguish successful from failed divergences
whether divergence affects win probability, excursion, timing or payoff shape
classical oscillator divergence versus a broader weakening-of-selling-pressure state

DISCOVERY.LABEL: DISCOVERY / PREVIOUSLY OBSERVED
DISCOVERY.ROLE: estimation and mechanism research; never independent validation evidence

VALIDATION.LABEL: VALIDATION / PREVIOUSLY UNSEEN
VALIDATION.ROLE: the only source of an independent validation statement; evaluated once

POOLED.LABEL: POOLED FULL HISTORY
POOLED.ROLE: estimation, mechanism, stability, descriptive modelling, heterogeneity; never independent replication, confirmation or fresh holdout evidence

SLICES.GAP: decisions in (2024-12-28, 2025-01-01) belong to no slice (their 96h windows would straddle the slices)

BOUNDARIES.DERIVATION: the longest forward read is T + 96h (bracket, forward return, MFE/MAE, time-to); every lookback (detector warm-up, book baseline 720h, OI 24h/leg/6h, volume baseline 720h, EMA168, RET_7D, market 24h) only reads before T. Last decision = E1 start - 96h - 24h margin = 2026-08-11T00:00Z; read horizon = 2026-08-15T00:00Z (exclusive).
BOUNDARIES.OBJECTS: monthly klines only up to 2026-07 (the 2026-08 monthly file contains E1 bytes); daily klines, bookDepth and metrics only up to 2026-08-14
BOUNDARIES.DETECTOR_GUARD: the SEED-0001 detector refuses windows reaching 2025; for this program its guard constant is substituted, inside a scoped context only, by the E1 holdout start; detector logic unchanged

PANEL_RULE: the feasibility-qualified panel; no symbol added or removed after protected outcomes are opened
DETECTOR: SEED0001_DETECTOR_V1 unchanged; discovery episodes must reproduce the V0 per-symbol digests

ARMS.RULE: definitions unchanged; never altered after opening

PRIMARY_PRACTICAL.QUESTION: Conditional on an already-present support state, does regular bullish divergence improve the subsequent trading outcome?

SECONDARY_MECHANISTIC.QUESTION: Does the contribution of divergence differ depending on whether support is present?

OUTCOMES.BRACKET: SEED-0001 definitions: entry close of bar i+3, stop low_i (low < S), target E + kR, same minute = stop, timeout = NEUTRAL; Y1/Y2 at 48h and 96h
OUTCOMES.COSTS: round trip 0.0010 of entry; COST_R = 0.0010 x E / R
OUTCOMES.NET_R: NET_Rk_cap = k (WIN), -1 (LOSS) or FWD_R_cap (NEUTRAL, exit at the cap close), minus COST_R

CONTINUOUS.T_MFE_H_cap: hours to the first minute at the window max high
CONTINUOUS.T_MAE_H_cap: hours to the first minute at the window min low
CONTINUOUS.T_HIT_P1R_H: hours to the first minute with high >= E + R within 96h (none if not hit)
CONTINUOUS.T_HIT_M1R_H: hours to the first minute with low < S within 96h (none if not hit)

OUTCOMES.RESOLUTION: 1m bars; missing minute in a window -> UNAVAILABLE (timestamps only)
OUTCOMES.NO_OPTIMIZATION: entry, stop, target, horizon and costs are never changed after validation outcomes are visible

FEATURE_REGISTRY.ROLE: point-in-time research covariates; never inclusion or exclusion rules

DEFINITIONS.DIV_CVD_SHARE: sum(2 taker_buy - volume) / sum(volume), bars j+1..i
DEFINITIONS.LEG_DEPTH_ATR: DECLINE_ATR (max high i-48..i minus low_i) / ATR14(i)
DEFINITIONS.SUPPORT_EXCESS: max support-hour imbalance minus its trailing P80
DEFINITIONS.BOOK_IMB_AT_LOW: hourly book imbalance of the pivot hour i
DEFINITIONS.NETFLOW24: net taker share, 24 bars ending at i+3
DEFINITIONS.SELL_PRESSURE_CHANGE: net taker share over bars j+1..i minus over the previous equal-length leg ending at j (positive = selling weakened into the new low)
DEFINITIONS.FLOW_AFTER_LOW: net taker share over bars i+1..i+3
DEFINITIONS.OI_CHG_LEG: OI(close of bar i) / OI(close of bar j) - 1
DEFINITIONS.LIQ_PROXY: 1 if OI(close of i) / OI(close of i - 6h) - 1 <= -1% AND max hourly volume of bars i-5..i >= 3 x median hourly volume of bars i-720..i-1
DEFINITIONS.NEW_LOW_30D_ATR: (min low of bars i-720..i-1 - low_i) / ATR14(i)
DEFINITIONS.MKT_RET24: mean over the six panel symbols of log(close at T / close at T - 24h)
DEFINITIONS.BTC_RET24: log(BTC close at T / BTC close at T - 24h)

FEATURE_REGISTRY.OI_PIT: Binance UM metrics sum_open_interest, 5m; a record labelled create_time is available at create_time + 5min; a value older than 30 min is missing
FEATURE_REGISTRY.MISSING: NaN; reported per feature and slice; complete-case only inside the models that use the feature
FEATURE_REGISTRY.DEEPER_STATE_FLOW_OI: 1 if SELL_PRESSURE_CHANGE > 0 and OI_CHG_LEG <= 0 (no oscillator input)

INFERENCE.MODEL: OLS (linear probability for binary outcomes) with arm dummies (D reference), symbol fixed effects and the SEED-0001 covariates (log RV24, sin/cos hour, DECLINE_ATR, NETFLOW24, RISK_ATR); pooled models add a slice fixed effect
INFERENCE.VARIANCE: CR1 with panel-wide UTC-week clusters (all symbols in a week share one cluster), t(G - 1); cross-symbol episodes are never treated as independent
INFERENCE.BOOTSTRAP: primary A - B: pairs bootstrap over whole weeks, 4999 resamples, seed 20261007, percentile 95% CI
INFERENCE.SUB_GROUP_MODELS: by symbol: arm-only, CR1 by week; by half-year / year: arm-only with symbol fixed effects; heterogeneity Q with inverse-variance weights (descriptive)

VALIDATION_LABELS.FORM: a list of descriptive tags, never a forced PASS/FAIL
RULES: INCONCLUSIVE_SAMPLE if validation A episodes < 30 or A week clusters < 30
SAME_DIRECTION / OPPOSITE_DIRECTION: sign of the validation estimate vs the discovery estimate of the same frozen model
COMPATIBLE_WITH_ZERO / DISTINGUISHABLE_FROM_ZERO: CR1 95% CI includes 0 or not
ECONOMICALLY_SMALL: point estimate < 0.05 and CI upper bound < 0.15
HETEROGENEOUS_ACROSS_SYMBOLS / NO_DETECTED_SYMBOL_HETEROGENEITY: symbol-level Q p < 0.05 or not (no detected heterogeneity is not evidence of stability)

STAGE_1_VALIDATION_ONCE: A/B/C/D counts by symbol; arm summaries with WIN/LOSS/NEUTRAL counts
frozen model for every outcome: A - B, interaction, A - D, C - D with CR1 CIs
by symbol and by half-year (Y1_48H, FWD_R_48H) with heterogeneity Q
the same for the discovery slice (comparison)
persist VALIDATION.json and the per-episode validation CSV before stage 2; a second stage-1 run is refused
STAGE_2_POOLED_AND_MECHANISM: pooled models with a slice fixed effect for every outcome
by year and by symbol (pooled) with heterogeneity Q
feature SMD (A vs B) and missingness per slice and pooled

within-support models: M0 DIV; M1 DIV + standardized mechanism subset (complete cases); M2 RSI/MACD/CVD family flags with and without the subset; M3 DEEPER_STATE_FLOW_OI alone and with DIV; M0 on NET_R1_48H
failure states within A and within B: one standardized feature at a time (symbol and slice fixed effects, CR1), Holm across features
stage 2 verifies that the validation episodes reproduce the persisted CSV byte-for-byte
PLANNED_ANALYSES.LABEL_OF_STAGE_2: EXPLORATORY; kept separate from the frozen arm-level estimates

PROHIBITED_AFTER_OPENING: any change of detector, support or divergence rule, arm definition, threshold, horizon, outcome, cost, entry, stop or target
any change of the symbol panel
any subgroup selection or filter presented as a result
presenting pooled results as independent replication, confirmation or fresh holdout evidence
promoting A - D or an exploratory model to the primary
PROSPECTIVE: not activated; the stream after 2026-10-05 stays a future independent resource
